goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: The root cause of INC-1003 is an expired TLS certificate on auth-gateway. The recommended remediation is certificate_rotation for the domain *.auth.internal.example.com.

story: You are an on-call engineer. There is an open incident INC-1003 affecting the auth-gateway service. Users are unable to log in and there are TLS handshake failures. Ask the agent to diagnose INC-1003. Do NOT ask the agent to call request_remediation — only ask for a diagnosis and remediation recommendation. Accept whatever the agent reports as its final diagnosis.
starting_sentence: Investigate incident INC-1003. Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and what remediation action you would recommend.
